voices.name: l00
voices.text: The harder you chase money, <#0.3#> the faster it runs.
voices.caption: The harder you chase money, the faster it runs.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: People who thrive check their soul's mood <#0.2#> before they calculate.
voices.caption: People who thrive check their soul's mood before they calculate.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Does this work make my soul lighter, <#0.2#> or heavier?
voices.caption: Does this work make my soul lighter, or heavier?

voices.name: l03
voices.text: When you do what makes your soul glad, <#0.2#> you're not just working. You're existing as yourself.
voices.caption: When you do what makes your soul glad, you're not just working. You're existing as yourself.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Martin Scorsese said it best. <#0.2#> The most personal is the most creative.
voices.caption: Martin Scorsese said it best. The most personal is the most creative.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: And someone who exists as themselves is joyful and full from within. <#0.2#> People, opportunities and money flow in, following that fullness.
voices.caption: And someone who exists as themselves is joyful and full from within. People, opportunities and money flow in, following that fullness.

voices.name: l06
voices.text: What ran away when you chased it <#0.2#> finds you when you walk your own path.
voices.caption: What ran away when you chased it finds you when you walk your own path.
